evidence_type: Owner-driven disconnect/reconnect of H1; agent read-only ADB before and after

interpretation.conclusion: Optimized-for-audio policy (1000) did not survive disconnect/reconnect. Android returned to legacy value 3 = Best effort / adaptive ABR. LDAC still negotiated, but quality policy reset.
interpretation.note: codecSpecific1 uses two encodings: 1000-1003 and legacy 0-3. Value 3 maps to adaptive per CodecMonitor.ldacMode.
not_proven: Whether any app re-applies a saved preference on reconnect
Whether policy persists across HFP/call switching
Whether 660 kbps is measured throughput (it is a stack-reported value, and HAL reported SBC at capture time)

implication: Any quality profile feature must treat remembered preference as UNKNOWN until re-applied and verified after reconnect. Opt-in reapplication needs device/LDAC/association checks and a single setter call.
